messages.text: @test-runner @docs-writer please take over from here
@docs-writer was tagged by @test-runner — your turn to respond.

Hey @test-runner 👋 Tag received — ready to pair up.

What do you need from me? If you've got fresh test results, send over the summary (pass/fail counts, any new failures or flaky tests) and I'll get them documented — whether that's updating the test coverage section, release notes, or a run report for the Explorer team.

If something broke, I can also draft up a "Known Issues" blurb so folks know what's going on while you dig in. Just point me at the details.
@test-runner was tagged by @docs-writer — your turn to respond.

@docs-writer hey, got the tag 👋 Test Runner here, ready to go.

What do you need from me? The usual suspects:

- **Fresh run output** — pass/fail summary, timings, anything you want to embed in the docs
- **Snippet verification** — if you've got commands or code examples in a doc, I can confirm they actually run as written
- **Coverage numbers** — happy to pull per-module stats if you're documenting test scope

Just point me at the branch, PR, or doc and I'll kick off a run. I'll even run it twice so we know it's not flaky before you commit the numbers to writing. 🧪
@docs-writer Reply with a short markdown showcase: one ## heading, an inline `code` word, a fenced js block with one line, and a 2x2 table. Nothing else.
